latestVersion.changelog:
Third and final pass on the security findings: the TUI was building shell commands out of listing URLs.

最后一轮安全修复：TUI 曾把房源链接拼进 shell 命令。

openExternal() passed its argument to exec() as a template string with only double quotes escaped. Several call sites hand it listing URLs and file paths read out of reports — scraped data — so a URL containing ; ... or $(...) or backticks would have run as a shell command. Quoting is not a defence against shell syntax; not involving a shell is.

openExternal() 把参数拼进 exec() 的模板字符串，只转义了双引号。多个调用点传入的是抓取来的房源链接与报告里的文件路径，因此链接里含 ; ...、$(...) 或反引号就会被当作 shell 命令执行。加引号挡不住 shell 语法，正确做法是不经过 shell。

Now: execFile with an argument array, so nothing is ever parsed by a shell. Plus an allow-list — http(s) goes to your browser, files must resolve inside the repo and exist, and any other scheme (javascript:, smb://, ...) is refused with a message.

现在：改用 execFile 传参数数组，参数永不经过 shell；另加白名单——http(s) 交给浏览器，文件必须解析后仍落在仓库内且真实存在，其它 scheme 一律拒绝并提示。

Also: the map regeneration call was exec("node <path>") too; it is now execFile(process.execPath, [...]), which also stops depending on node being on PATH.

另外：重新生成地图的那次调用原先也是 exec("node <path>")，现改为 execFile(process.execPath, [...])，顺带不再依赖 PATH 上的 node。

selftest runs the real openExternal against hostile input (12 cases): normal URLs and in-repo files still open, while '; rm -rf /', '$(whoami)', backticks, javascript:, smb://, out-of-repo paths and missing files are all refused. Disabling the allow-list makes three assertions fail.

自测跑真实的 openExternal 喂恶意输入（12 例）：正常 URL 与仓库内文件照常打开，而 '; rm -rf /'、'$(whoami)'、反引号、javascript:、smb://、仓库外路径、不存在的文件全部被拒。去掉白名单会让 3 条断言失败。

This package 1.0.8 = repo v0.3.1 + commits f8acbc0, bf874f8, 42cc61b.
